The Economic and Financial Crimes Commission has arraigned a former accountant of Uyi Technical Limited, Victor Osayamwen, over an alleged N55.3m fraud. EFCC disclosed this in a short statement released on its X page on Thursday. Osayamwen was arraigned on Thursday before Justice Irele Ifijeh of the Edo State High Court sitting in Benin City by the Benin Zonal Directorate of the EFCC. The commission alleged that the defendant, while serving as the company’s accountant, fraudulently transferred N55.3m to his personal account and those of his associates. The funds were allegedly converted to their personal use. Add us to your Preferred Sources PUNCH Metro reported a similar case on Wednesday that EFCC arraigned a socialite, Halimat Tejuosho, before the Federal Capital Territory High Court in Gwagwalada, Abuja, over an alleged N603.4m scam involving a promise to secure a woman’s appointment as Group Managing Director of the Nigerian National Petroleum Corporation. Tejuosho was arraigned before Justice A.S. Adepoju on a five-count charge bordering on advance fee fraud, obtaining money by false pretence and criminal conduct. The charge, marked FCT/CR/473/2026, accused her and one Gidado Ibrahim of obtaining N603.4m from Oluseye Yomi-Sholoye between August and October 2024 under the pretence that they would facilitate her appointment as NNPC GMD. ‎The commission also accused Tejuosho of receiving N259.9m and N50m, among other sums, into bank accounts allegedly linked to her and Haleems Integrated Services Limited, knowing that the money was proceeds of crime.
